mapper.select:
select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, max(t.dec_qic) as periods, max(t.dt_riq) as planDate, sum(t.dec_shijzj) as rentAmount, sum(t.dec_benj) as principalAmount, sum(t.dec_lix) interestAmount from hengyun.sy_pm_zujjhb t left join hengyun.sy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join hengyun.sy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join hengyun.sY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join hengyun.sy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and not exists (select zc.vc_hethm from hengyun.sy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm) and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
group by h.vc_hetgs, h.vc_hethm, to_char(t.dt_riq, 'yyyy-MM') order by h.vc_hethm, max(t.dt_riq)

select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, t.dec_qic as periods, t.dt_riq as planDate, t.dec_shijzj as rentAmount, t.dec_benj as principalAmount, t.dec_lix interestAmount from hengyun.sy_pm_zujjhb t left join hengyun.sy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join hengyun.sy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join hengyun.sY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join hengyun.sy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and not exists (select zc.vc_hethm from hengyun.sy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm) and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
order by h.vc_hethm, t.dec_qic

SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID , rownum rn FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM hengyun.rpt_firr_new GROUP BY contract_id HAVING TRUNC(max(PLAN_DATE)) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY CONTRACT_ID ) WHERE rownum <= #{params.end} ) WHERE rn > #{params.start}

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'SYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 max(a.plan_list) as periods, -- 期项 max(a.plan_date) as planDate, -- 承付日期 sum(a.rent) as rentAmount, --租金 sum(a.net_flow) as cashFlow, --净流量 sum(a.naf_cut) as principalAmount, --本金 sum(a.interest) as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM hengyun.rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN hengyun.sy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
group by a.contract_id, to_char(a.plan_date, 'yyyy-MM'), b.vc_hetgs ORDER BY a.contract_id, max(a.plan_date)

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'SYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 a.plan_list as periods, -- 期项 a.plan_date as planDate, -- 承付日期 a.rent as rentAmount, --租金 a.net_flow as cashFlow, --净流量 a.naf_cut as principalAmount, --本金 a.interest as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM hengyun.rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN hengyun.sy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
ORDER BY a.contract_id, a.plan_list

select 'SYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hethm AS contractCode, t.Dec_qic AS periods, t.DT_RiQ AS planDate, f.dec_yisfje AS actualRepaymentRentAmount, f.dec_yisje AS actualRepaymentPrincipalAmount, f.dec_yislx AS actualRepaymentInteresAmount
from hengyun.SY_PM_ZUJJHB t left join hengyun.SY_FM_ShouFKB f on t.vc_hetbid = f.vc_hetbid and t.dec_qic = f.dec_qis and f.vc_xianjlxm = '100009' inner join hengyun.sy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = f.vc_hetbid where not exists ( select zc.vc_hethm from hengyun.sy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm )
and h.vc_hethm in
#{item}
order by to_Number(Dec_qic)

select t.* from ( select t.vc_wangybh as ebankSerialNumber, t.vc_pingzzy as ebankNumber, t.vc_wangygs as collectionAccountsBank, t.dec_ruzje as incomeAmount, t.dec_weiczje as nonOutcomeAmount, t.vc_hethm as contractCode, t.vc_xingm as clientName, t.vc_hetzt as contractStatus
from hengyun.rpt_yick_info t where to_char(t.his_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} ) t left join hengyun.sy_pm_hetb h on t.contractCode = h.vc_hethm where 1=1

select t.his_date, case when substr(t.vc_wangybh, 0, 3) = 'GHG' then t.vc_pich else t.vc_wangybh end as vc_wangybh, t.vc_pich, t.vc_wangyb_hy, t.vc_daozyh, t.vc_daozyhzh, t.vc_fukzh, t.dt_daodsj, t.dec_daozje, t.dec_kehxje, t.dec_yihxje, null vc_biz, t.vc_wangygs, t.vc_baozjgs, t.vc_spmc, t.vc_zhaiy from ( select rp.his_date, rp.vc_wangybh, rp.vc_pich, rp.vc_wangybh vc_wangyb_hy, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, rp.dt_daodsj, rp.dec_daozje , rp.dec_kehxje, rp.dec_daozje-rp.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, null vc_biz, te.codename vc_wangygs, wybzj.vc_baozjgs, wybzj.vc_spmc, w.vc_zhaiy from ( select * from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (dt_daodsj < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') or (vc_wangybh not like 'KEB%' and vc_wangybh not like 'CEBMS%')) and vc_mark is null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' ) ) rp left join hengyun.gy_fm_wangyjlb w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyun.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' left join hengyun.sy_op_spbzjwyglb wybzj on wybzj.vc_wangybh = w.vc_wangybh union all select his_date, vc_pich, vc_pich, to_char(vc_wangyb_hy) vc_wangyb_hy, vc_shoukyh, vc_shoukyhzh, null, null, dec_daozje, dec_kehxje, dec_yihxje, null vc_biz, vc_wangygs, null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc, null vc_zhaiy from ( select rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich, wm_concat(rp.vc_wangybh) vc_wangyb_hy, k.vc_shoukyh, k.vc_shoukyhzh, sum(rp.dec_daozje) dec_daozje, sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_kehxje, sum(rp.dec_daozje)-sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_yihxje, te.codename vc_wangygs from ( select * from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where rp.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.dt_daodsj >= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (rp.vc_wangybh like 'KEB%' or rp.vc_wangybh like 'CEBMS%') and vc_mark is null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and (kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' or kz.vc_wangybh like 'GHG%') ) ) rp left join hengyun.sy_fm_koukfphppcb p on rp.vc_pich = p.vc_pich left join ( select * from ( select vc_koukfphppcbid, vc_shoukyh, vc_shoukyhzh, row_number() over (partition by vc_koukfphppcbid order by dt_chuangjsj desc) rown from hengyun.sy_fm_koukjlb k ) where rown = 1 ) k on k.vc_koukfphppcbid = p.vc_koukfphppcbid left join hengyun.gy_fm_wangyjlb w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' group by rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich, te.codename, k.vc_shoukyh, k.vc_shoukyhzh ) w2 union all select null, vc_wangybh, null, vc_wangybh vc_wangyb_hy, null, null, null, null, dec_daozje, dec_kehxje, dec_daozje-dec_kehxje, vc_biz, '海通恒信国际融资租赁股份有限公司', null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc, null vc_zhaiy from hengyun.gy_fm_wangyjlb_none where 1 = 1 union all select rp.his_date, rp.vc_wangybh, rp.vc_pich, rp.vc_wangybh vc_wangyb_hy, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, rp.dt_daodsj, rp.dec_daozje , rp.dec_kehxje, rp.dec_daozje-rp.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, rp.vc_mark vc_biz, te.codename vc_wangygs, wybzj.vc_baozjgs, wybzj.vc_spmc, w.vc_zhaiy from ( select * from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (dt_daodsj <to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') or vc_wangybh not like '%KEB%') and vc_mark is not null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' ) ) rp left join hengyun.gy_fm_wangyjlb@hydb104 w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyun.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' left join hengyun.sy_op_spbzjwyglb wybzj on wybzj.vc_wangybh = w.vc_wangybh union all select his_date, vc_pich, vc_pich, to_char(vc_wangyb_hy) vc_wangyb_hy, vc_shoukyh, vc_shoukyhzh, null, null, dec_daozje, dec_kehxje, dec_yihxje, null vc_biz, vc_wangygs, null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc, null vc_zhaiy from ( select rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich, wm_concat(rp.vc_wangybh) vc_wangyb_hy, k.vc_shoukyh, k.vc_shoukyhzh, sum(rp.dec_daozje) dec_daozje, sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_kehxje, sum(rp.dec_daozje)-sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_yihxje, te.codename vc_wangygs from ( select * from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.dt_daodsj >= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.vc_wangybh like '%KEB%' and vc_mark is not null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyun.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' ) ) rp left join hengyun.sy_fm_koukfphppcb@hydb104 p on rp.vc_pich = p.vc_pich left join ( select * from ( select vc_koukfphppcbid, vc_shoukyh, vc_shoukyhzh, row_number() over (partition by vc_koukfphppcbid order by dt_chuangjsj desc) rown from hengyun.sy_fm_koukjlb@hydb104 k ) where rown = 1 ) k on k.vc_koukfphppcbid = p.vc_koukfphppcbid left join hengyun.gy_fm_wangyjlb@hydb104 w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyun.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' group by rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich, te.codename, k.vc_shoukyh, k.vc_shoukyhzh ) w2 ) t where 1 = 1
